body.description: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

get.description: Liveness and database check for uptime monitoring. Reveals nothing else.

post.description: Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookies.

200.description: Signed in (a session, with the cookies set), or the password was right and a second step is needed (a challenge, no session)

401.description: Wrong email or password. The same answer for an unknown email.

post.description: The second step of sign-in: the six-digit code from the authenticator app (or a recovery code) plus the challenge from sign-in. Sets the session cookies.

401.description: `invalid_code` (wrong, already used or expired) or `invalid_challenge` (start again from the password)

post.description: Starts setting up the authenticator app: returns a new secret (to type in or scan) and the address an app can open. Asking again replaces an unconfirmed secret.

200.description: The secret to add to the app

401.description: The challenge is missing, expired or for another step

post.description: Confirms the first code from the app, turns two-step sign-in on, signs the person in (cookies set) and returns ten single-use recovery codes, shown this once.

409.description: `no_setup`: no secret was started, or it is already on

post.description: Swaps the refresh cookie for a new pair of cookies.

401.description: No valid session. `refresh_in_progress` means retry once.

post.description: Ends the session and clears the cookies. Always succeeds.
Asks for a password-reset email. The answer is always 202, whether or not the address has an account, so it cannot be used to find out who is registered. Limited per account and per address.

202.description: If the address has an account, an email is on its way

post.description: Sets a new password with the token from the emailed link. The token works once. Ends every session the account had.

400.description: The link is wrong, already used or expired (the same answer for all three)

422.description: The new password is not acceptable; the link still works

get.description: Who is signed in, from the signed access cookie. No database read.

401.description: Not signed in, or the access cookie expired

post.description: Removes a person's two-step sign-in and ends their sessions, so they set it up again at the next sign-in. For a lost phone with no recovery codes. Super Admin only; nobody resets their own.

400.description: Nobody can reset their own two-step sign-in

get.description: What the web app needs to draw itself for this school: name, sections, wording, modules, theme.

503.description: This school has not been set up yet

put.description: Replaces the school's theme. Refused unless every colour pair passes the readability check.

422.description: The theme is not readable. Nothing was saved.

get.description: The notices, holidays, routines, vacancies and posts the public may read today, by Nepal's clock: live items from their publish day to the end of their hide-after day. Urgent first, then newest. The same for every visitor.

200.description: What is on the site today

get.description: Every item in every state, most recently touched first, at most 200, WITHOUT the text (fetch one item for that). `state` says where each stands today, and `todayBs` is today in Bikram Sambat.

post.description: Saves a new item as a draft. It is not public until it is published.

403.description: Not allowed (for example, switched off since signing in)

get.description: One item with its text and contact, for the edit form.

patch.description: Changes some of an item's words or dates. Send only what changes. The kind and the status cannot be changed here. A live item's change is public at once.

403.description: Not allowed (for example, switched off since signing in)

422.description: The result would break a rule; nothing changed

post.description: Puts a draft on the public site, from its publish day. Two people doing it at once: one succeeds, the other gets 409.

403.description: Not allowed (for example, switched off since signing in)

post.description: Takes an item off the public site. It goes back to a draft and can be published again.

403.description: Not allowed (for example, switched off since signing in)

get.description: Converts a Bikram Sambat day (YYYY-MM-DD, month as a number) to AD. Refuses a day that does not exist and any year outside BS 2000 to 2083.

confidence.description: `disputed` means public calendars disagree on this day: confirm it against the certificate.

422.description: Not a real day, or a year that has not been verified

get.description: Converts an AD day (YYYY-MM-DD) to Bikram Sambat. Refuses a day that does not exist and any day outside BS 2000 to 2083.

confidence.description: `disputed` means public calendars disagree on this day: confirm it against the certificate.

422.description: Not a real day, or outside the verified years

get.description: The words of the school's six fixed public pages (home, programmes, admission, scholarships, facilities, contact), from its pack. `site` is null before the school has been provisioned with them. The same for every visitor.

200.description: The fixed pages' words, or null
